blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Custom Metal Gate Cost in North Shore & Geelong?
blogPosts.excerpt: A complete breakdown of metal gate pricing for North Shore homeowners, including materials, automation, and installation across Geelong.
body: If you live in North Shore or anywhere across the greater Geelong region and are considering a new metal gate, understanding the costs involved is the essential first step. At Metal Art & Design, Brooke and the team fabricate everything from simple manual pedestrian gates to fully automated driveway gates with intercom integration, so the pricing range can vary significantly depending on your design requirements, material choices, and the level of automation you need. A basic single-leaf steel driveway gate in North Shore typically starts from around $1,500 to $3,000 installed, while larger double-leaf automated gates with custom laser-cut designs can range from $5,000 to $12,000 or more.

The material you choose has the single biggest impact on the final cost of your gate. Mild steel is the most popular and affordable option for North Shore properties — it is strong, versatile, and takes powder-coat finishes beautifully, which helps protect against the coastal humidity that can affect Geelong-area homes. Aluminium is lighter and more corrosion-resistant, making it ideal for pool fencing gates or properties closer to Corio Bay, but it typically costs 20-30% more than steel. For a premium, low-maintenance look, stainless steel or corten steel gates make a bold architectural statement and are increasingly popular with modern homes in Hamlyn Heights and Bell Park.

Automation is another significant cost factor that North Shore homeowners should consider carefully. A reliable motor and gate automation system — including the motor, control board, remotes, safety sensors, and a battery backup — generally adds between $1,500 and $3,500 to your gate project depending on the weight and size of the gate. For heavy double-leaf steel gates, you will need dual motors with higher torque ratings, which pushes the automation cost toward the upper end. Intercom systems, keypad entry, and smartphone-controlled openers are popular add-ons that add another $300 to $800. Metal Art & Design recommends automating during the initial fabrication for the cleanest integration and most reliable long-term operation.

The design complexity of your gate also affects the price. A straightforward flat-panel steel gate with a simple powder-coat finish is the most budget-friendly option, while intricate laser-cut patterns, decorative scrollwork, or mixed-material designs incorporating timber or stainless steel accents require significantly more design time and fabrication hours. At Metal Art & Design, we offer a free design consultation at our Foch St workshop in North Shore where Brooke can sketch ideas, show you material samples, and provide a fixed quote before any work begins. This upfront approach means you know exactly what you are paying — no hidden costs, no nasty surprises.

Installation costs in the North Shore and Geelong area typically range from $400 to $1,200 depending on whether you need new posts set in concrete, modifications to existing driveway openings, or integration with existing fencing and walls. If your property has a steep driveway, difficult access, or requires electrical work to run power to the gate motor, expect installation costs at the higher end. Metal Art & Design handles all installation in-house rather than subcontracting, which ensures consistent quality and means Brooke is personally accountable for every gate we install in North Shore and surrounds.

To get an accurate price for your custom metal gate in North Shore, the best approach is to contact Metal Art & Design for a free on-site consultation. Brooke will visit your property, assess the access, measure the opening, discuss your design preferences, and provide a fixed written quote — usually within 48 hours. Whether you are in North Shore, Corio, Lara, or anywhere in the Geelong region, we guarantee the same level of local, personal service and transparent pricing that has made us one of the area's most trusted metal fabricators.

blogPosts.title: Corten Steel Garden Features: A North Shore Homeowner's Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: Everything North Shore and Geelong homeowners need to know about corten steel planters, screens, and sculptures for modern gardens.
body: Corten steel — also known as weathering steel — has become one of the most sought-after materials for outdoor garden features across North Shore and the wider Geelong region, and for good reason. This remarkable alloy develops a rich, rusty-orange patina when exposed to the elements, creating a natural protective layer that eliminates the need for painting or ongoing maintenance. For North Shore homeowners looking to add warmth, texture, and a contemporary edge to their outdoor spaces, corten steel planter boxes, privacy screens, water features, and garden sculptures offer a perfect blend of raw beauty and long-lasting durability that suits the Geelong climate beautifully.

One of the most popular corten steel applications at Metal Art & Design is the custom planter box. Unlike mass-produced options from big-box stores, a locally fabricated corten planter from our North Shore workshop can be sized exactly to your garden beds, built with proper drainage, and designed with clean welded seams that look as good up close as they do from across the yard. Corten planters start from approximately $400 for a simple rectangular unit and range up to $2,500 or more for large, multi-tiered installations. The patina typically develops over 6 to 12 months in the Geelong climate, transitioning from dark brown to the signature warm orange tones that make corten so distinctive.

Privacy screens and decorative panels are another high-demand corten product for North Shore properties. Laser-cut corten screens serve a dual purpose — they block unwanted sightlines from neighbours or streets while functioning as genuine works of art. Popular designs include native Australian botanicals, geometric patterns, and custom motifs that reflect your personal style. A standard corten privacy screen panel measuring approximately 1.8 metres tall by 1 metre wide typically costs between $800 and $1,800 installed at a North Shore property, depending on the complexity of the laser-cut pattern and the mounting requirements. Multiple panels can be combined to screen entire fence lines or create dramatic courtyard enclosures.

Corten steel water features have also surged in popularity across Geelong gardens, and Metal Art & Design has fabricated dozens for properties in North Shore, Corio, and surrounding suburbs. A corten water wall or freestanding fountain creates a striking focal point while the soothing sound of running water transforms your outdoor entertaining area. Because corten is naturally corrosion-resistant, it performs exceptionally well in water features without the degradation issues that affect standard mild steel. Fabrication costs for a medium-sized corten water feature typically range from $1,500 to $4,500 including the reservoir, pump, and plumbing connections.

A common question from North Shore homeowners is whether corten steel will stain their surrounding surfaces. The short answer is yes — during the initial weathering phase, rust-coloured runoff can stain concrete, pavers, and timber decking. At Metal Art & Design, we advise all clients to either position corten features on gravel, soil, or sacrificial surfaces, or to install a discreet drip edge or drainage channel during installation. Brooke can walk you through the best placement options during your free consultation at our Foch St workshop to ensure your corten feature enhances rather than damages your North Shore garden.

If you are considering a corten steel feature for your North Shore or Geelong property, Metal Art & Design offers a complete design-to-installation service. Start with a free consultation at our North Shore workshop where you can see corten samples, discuss design ideas, and receive a fixed quote. Whether it is a single planter box or a full courtyard transformation with screens, a water feature, and custom seating, the team at Metal Art & Design will fabricate every element locally and install it with care.

blogPosts.title: Laser-Cut Metal Screens for Privacy: North Shore & Geelong Options
blogPosts.excerpt: A comprehensive guide to laser-cut privacy screens — materials, designs, pricing, and installation tips for North Shore properties.
body: Privacy is one of the top concerns for homeowners in North Shore and across the Geelong region, where growing medium-density development means fences and boundary treatments need to work harder than ever. Laser-cut metal screens have emerged as one of the most effective and visually stunning solutions, offering complete visual privacy without the heavy, fortress-like appearance of solid walls. At Metal Art & Design, we design and fabricate custom laser-cut screens at our North Shore workshop from steel, aluminium, and corten — each material offering distinct advantages depending on your property, budget, and aesthetic preferences.

Mild steel is the most popular material choice for laser-cut privacy screens in North Shore, offering an excellent balance of strength, weight, and cost. A steel screen can be powder-coated in virtually any colour to match your home's exterior palette, which is important for maintaining a cohesive look across your property. For a typical residential privacy screen measuring 1.8 metres tall by 1 metre wide, fabricated from 3mm or 4mm mild steel with a standard powder-coat finish, you can expect pricing between $650 and $1,400 including materials and fabrication. Installation adds approximately $200 to $500 depending on whether you need new posts or are mounting to existing walls or fences.

Aluminium screens offer superior corrosion resistance compared to steel, which makes them an excellent choice for North Shore properties that experience exposure to salt air from Corio Bay or properties with swimming pools that require compliance with Australian Standard AS 1926 for pool fencing. Aluminium screens are also significantly lighter, which simplifies installation and reduces the structural requirements of your mounting posts or walls. The trade-off is cost — aluminium laser-cut screens typically run 25-40% more than equivalent steel screens, so budget approximately $900 to $2,000 for a standard panel with powder-coat finish.

Design is where laser-cut screens truly differentiate themselves from any other privacy solution. The CNC laser-cutting process at Metal Art & Design can reproduce virtually any pattern, from clean geometric grids and tessellating hexagons to intricate native Australian botanical illustrations featuring banksias, eucalyptus leaves, and wattle blossoms. We can also incorporate your house number, family name, or a completely custom pattern designed in collaboration with an architect or landscape designer. The design consultation is free at our North Shore workshop, and Brooke will produce digital mock-ups so you can visualise exactly how the finished screen will look in your specific location before committing.

Installation considerations for North Shore properties include council requirements, setback distances, and structural engineering. In the City of Greater Geelong, freestanding screens and fences generally do not require a planning permit if they are under 2 metres in height and located within your property boundary, but it is always wise to confirm with the council before proceeding. Metal Art & Design handles all structural requirements, including footings for freestanding screens and engineered fixings for wall-mounted panels, ensuring your installation is both compliant and built to withstand the Geelong region's variable weather conditions, including strong southerly winds off the bay.

For North Shore homeowners who want a complete privacy solution rather than individual panels, Metal Art & Design offers a full courtyard and outdoor room service. This involves measuring your space, designing a cohesive screen system that wraps around your entertaining area, fabricating all panels in our local workshop, and installing everything in a single coordinated project. This approach typically saves 10-15% compared to purchasing individual panels separately and ensures a seamless, professional finish. Contact Brooke at Metal Art & Design on 0416 440 810 to book your free design consultation at our Foch St, North Shore workshop.

blogPosts.title: The Best Time to Commission Metalwork in Geelong: A Seasonal Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: When should North Shore and Geelong homeowners book their metal fabrication project for the best price and fastest turnaround?
body: Timing your metalwork project correctly can save you money and ensure faster turnaround — and for homeowners in North Shore and across the Geelong region, understanding the seasonal rhythms of the metal fabrication industry is key to getting the best outcome. At Metal Art & Design, we fabricate year-round at our Foch St workshop, but demand patterns throughout the year significantly affect scheduling and, occasionally, pricing. Generally speaking, the quieter months of late autumn and winter — May through August — offer the shortest lead times and most flexibility for Geelong-area projects.

Spring is historically the busiest period for metal fabricators in the Geelong region, and Metal Art & Design is no exception. September through November sees a surge in demand for gates, fences, and outdoor features as homeowners prepare their properties for the warmer entertaining season. If you want a new driveway gate, privacy screen, or garden feature installed and ready for summer, the ideal time to commission the work is during winter so fabrication is completed and installation can occur before the peak rush. Booking in June or July for a North Shore gate project, for example, typically results in a 3 to 4 week turnaround compared to 6 to 8 weeks during the spring peak.

Summer in Geelong brings its own considerations for metalwork. Extreme heat days — and the Geelong region regularly experiences temperatures above 35 degrees in January and February — can affect powder-coating processes and make outdoor installation work uncomfortable and less efficient. However, summer is the perfect time for smaller indoor metalwork projects such as furniture, shelving, and decorative items that do not require outdoor installation. Metal Art & Design also finds that summer is a popular time for North Shore homeowners to plan larger projects like architectural steelwork for home extensions, because it allows design and engineering to be completed during summer so fabrication can begin immediately when autumn demand drops.

The wet winter months in Geelong — particularly June and July — are actually ideal for fabrication work at our North Shore workshop because most of the heavy cutting, welding, and finishing happens indoors. This means winter projects often move faster than equivalent projects booked during the busier spring period. For corten steel features specifically, commissioning during late autumn is strategically clever because the wet winter months accelerate the beautiful rust-patina development, meaning your corten planter, screen, or sculpture will have fully developed its rich orange tones by the time spring arrives and you are entertaining outdoors.

Another important timing factor for North Shore homeowners is lead times for specialty materials. Stainless steel, corten steel, and certain aluminium alloys are not always held in stock locally and may need to be sourced from Melbourne or interstate suppliers. During peak periods, material procurement alone can add 1 to 2 weeks to your project timeline. Metal Art & Design maintains relationships with multiple suppliers and keeps common materials in stock at our Foch St workshop specifically to minimise these delays, but for unusual alloys or custom extrusions, planning ahead is always advisable.

The bottom line for North Shore and Geelong homeowners is this: the best time to start your metalwork project is right now, regardless of the season. Contact Metal Art & Design for a free consultation and fixed quote, and Brooke will provide an honest assessment of timing, cost, and material availability for your specific project. Whether you are planning a spring installation or a winter fabrication, early engagement means better planning, fewer surprises, and a finished piece of metalwork that exceeds your expectations. Call 0416 440 810 or visit 21 Foch St, North Shore to get started.
